result.title: AI Data Analysis: A New Approach - Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis
result.summary: AI data analysis today is three fragmented worlds: LLMs understand semantics but cannot compute; BI aggregates precisely but is stateless; ML processes large-scale data on a stateful kernel but lacks semantics. This paper proposes a combination mechanism, named Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis, that fills a still-open gap - the multi-engine joint context: the data context is embedded into LLM conversational analysis, where the LLM serves only as the semantic, reasoning, and orchestration layer (not computation) and connects four engines through the 1M context window - Python and R ML kernels, SQL over relational databases, Cypher over graph databases - yielding two multiplications, "semantics and precise computation" and "relational and graph", under enterprise-grade governance. The novelty is a four-dimensional coordinate system: horizontal (engine kinds), vertical (state flow - the watershed), spatial (business generalization), temporal (iterative convergence); a deterministic grounding method (one-shot injection of schema.json + notes.md, M+S) carries the spatial and temporal dimensions. Empirically, all four dimensions are substantiated: horizontally, four engines are quantified - SQL, Cypher (96.5% on CypherBench movie), ML in Python and R (TabReD weather); vertically, state flows across engines and grounding is reused across kernels; spatially, SQL generalizes across three business databases - AdventureWorks 91.3%, financial 95.3%, formula_1 94.6% (average), about 20-23 points above single-shot SOTA 74.45%; temporally, accuracy converges monotonically as notes accumulate. The core invariant - the separation of semantics from computation plus a cross-data-domain persistent context - does not expire as LLMs and agents evolve or engine forms change.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「多引擎联合状态数据分析」框架：LLM 仅作语义理解与调度层，经长上下文连接 Python/R、SQL、Cypher 四类引擎，并以四维坐标（引擎种类、状态流动、业务泛化、迭代收敛）和 schema.json + notes.md 一次性注入的 grounding 方法组织分析流程，在若干数据基准上报告准确率与收敛现象。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「外部持久上下文 + 跨引擎状态累积」与 LVR 中内部 latent 工作区是否必要的争论形成对照，notes 累积带来的单调收敛也可能供核查状态外部化与迭代收益的评价方式；但该文无视觉输入、无推理期 latent 状态生成，迁移线索需较多转换。
